existing_open_questions: I’ve already asked about continued Hugging Face publication of raw attempts and Opus 5.5 ARC-3 results. That remains an information gap. Without newer released attempts and reasoning, it is harder to examine how models reach their answers or compare Opus 4.5 with 5.5 on the same task.
